comment: Everything the installer fetches. Pinned hashes are checked; a null hash is computed and printed (pin it after review).

repo.comment: Our own files: the source tree of this repository at a ref (not a release).

holo_rootfs.comment: SteamOS Holo core for aarch64, Valve's public package server.

steam_client.comment: Steam client for linuxarm64 from Valve's public client CDN: the channel manifest lists zips (each with its sha256), unpacked into ~/.local/share/Steam like Steam's bootstrapper does.

steam_frame.comment: The Steam Frame's public recovery image (linked from store.steampowered.com/steamos/download/?ver=steamframe; '-latest' redirects to this versioned file): SteamVR arm64 (/opt/steamvr), GTK 2. Extracted by build_image.py (the rootfs is read with Linux tools). app 250820's public depots are x86 only.

meta_ota.comment: Meta's last Quest 1 OTA (full A/B payload). Its system and modem images are bit-identical to a headset on this build (checked 2026-11-04 against a dump).

holo_packages.comment: Holo's pacman repositories (Valve's public package server, the snapshot the rootfs comes from): the packages of device/packages.txt with all their dependencies, installed offline by build_image.py. Each file is checked against the repository database's sha256.

prebuilt.comment: Our binaries, built by .github/workflows/prebuilt.yml from this repository and published on its prebuilt branch: manifest.json lists each file's sha256.
